metadata.description: Odile Labs plugins for Claude Code: keep your agent inside your API (Odile Gate), reach businesses that have no API (Odile Direct), and a phone line that answers.

plugins.name: odile
plugins.description: Odile Gate keeps an agent inside the calls your API allows (per-app keys, allowed calls, loop breaker, approvals, audit log); the Odile MCP server lets an agent message or book a business that has no API (Odile Direct) and gives an app a phone line (25 cents a minute).
